Description: Replace store CCTV with cloud recorders viewable from head office
Screening_Reason: Systematic monitoring of a publicly accessible area (Art 35(3)(c))
Key_Risk: Excessive retention and remote access to footage
Mitigation_Action: 30-day retention; role-based access log; updated signage

Description: Use purchase history to tailor offers in the loyalty app
Key_Risk: Opaque profiling; marketing without valid consent
Mitigation_Action: Opt-in consent; preference centre; profiling notice in app

Description: Move HR records and payroll to a SaaS provider
Screening_Reason: New technology; large-scale employee data incl. health data
Mitigation_Action: Art 28 contract; transfer impact assessment; SSO and MFA

Description: Courier collects returns using name, address and phone
Screening_Reason: Screened out: existing processor, low-risk contact data

Description: Camera estimates age at self-checkout for restricted items
Key_Risk: Facial images processed without clear necessity
Mitigation_Action: On-device processing; no image storage; staff check offered as alternative

Project: Staff scheduling app with clock-in location
Description: Mobile app for rotas and clock-in at the store
Mitigation_Action: Geofence check at clock-in only; no continuous tracking
